violation_type.title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements (26 TAC §747.3111(d))
violation_type.short_title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements
violation_type.typical_finding: Children are being served nutrient and sugar added power in the place of 100% fruit juice. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver removed all powered drinks.
